entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which WUS assistance information capability is indicated and UE paging probability information may be negotiated.

entities.name: Requested WUS assistance information IE
entities.description: Information element in REGISTRATION REQUEST message that may contain UE paging probability information.

entities.name: Negotiated WUS assistance information IE
entities.description: Information element in REGISTRATION ACCEPT message that contains negotiated UE paging probability information.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE that may include Requested WUS assistance information IE.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by network that may include Negotiated WUS assistance information IE.

entities.name: UE paging probability information
entities.description: Assistance information used to determine the WUS group for paging UE.

entities.name: No emergency PDU session
entities.description: Condition where UE does not have an active emergency PDU session.

entities.name: Emergency PDU session active
entities.description: Condition where UE has an active emergency PDU session.

entities.name: WUS assistance information usage
entities.description: Property indicating whether UE can use WUS assistance information.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain Requested WUS assistance information IE.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain Negotiated WUS assistance information IE.
Requested WUS assistance information IE may contain UE paging probability information.
Negotiated WUS assistance information IE contains negotiated UE paging probability information.
Registration procedure for WUS assistance negotiation requires no emergency PDU session.
Emergency PDU session active condition prevents WUS assistance information usage.
Receipt of Negotiated WUS assistance information IE enables WUS assistance usage.
